test_title: PYST 24: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 16 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Anuj starts from Point A and drives 12 km towards East. He then takes a right turn, drives 8 km, turns right and drives 14 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 11 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 2 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90° turns only, unless specified.)
solution:
Given:

Anuj starts from Point A and drives 12 km towards East.

He then takes a right turn, drives 8 km, turns right and drives 14 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 11 km.

He takes a final right turn, drives 2 km and stops at Point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2a709c88cda8cd4eaa0a749a2572cde17b6e72ed3b31a77b0b529f49cce2372.png] 

Thus, Anuj should drive 3 km (11 km - 8 km) in the south direction in order to reach point A again.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
